scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/client
scripts.test: node --test scripts/setup.test.mjs scripts/launcher.test.mjs scripts/certbot.test.mjs && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/client
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build -w apps/client && node scripts/android.mjs
